title: Childhood saucer over football field, Artek camp and army sightings
summary: Kiran Ilum Xenov tells of Childhood saucer over football field, Artek camp and army sightings, about Childhood to Soviet army service at Football field; Artek camp near Mount Ayu-Dag, Crimea; Soviet army, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Football field; Artek camp near Mount Ayu-Dag, Crimea; Soviet army

tellings.quote: me. You know in childhood when we played football we saw a saucer hovering over the football field a few dozen boys watching it.

plain: A man named Kiran Ilum Xenov, who says he was taken by aliens in 1997, told podcast host Jesse Michels that as a boy he and a few dozen other boys playing football saw a saucer hovering over the field. He says he had more sightings at Artek, a famous Soviet children's summer camp near Mount Ayu-Dag in Crimea, and later while serving in the Soviet army, which he offers as a run of encounters across his early life.
